tool.name: AEGeAn ParsEval
tool.description: Compare two genome annotations using ParsEval

output.name: parseval_report
output.has_text: Comparison of reference and prediction annotations

tool.help:
# AEGeAn ParsEval
Compare two genome annotations in GFF3 format to measure their agreement.
## Inputs - **Reference annotation**: GFF3 file representing the reference annotation - **Prediction annotation**: GFF3 file representing the predicted annotation
## Output - **ParsEval report**: Text file containing similarity statistics and comparison results
